caption: find your sign. tag the one who's in tier one. mars stations retrograde at 10.4° virgo, 13:00 utc today, and backs into leo on feb 21.

slides.headline: *mars* turns retrograde in *virgo* today. here's who feels it
the planet of *drive* appears to back up
slides.body: earth is overtaking mars, so mars seems to slide back. it re-enters leo on feb 21 and stays retrograde into spring.

rows.label: virgo
rows.text: **it's in your sign.** slow the push, fix the plan.

rows.label: pisces
rows.text: partners slow down. renegotiate, don't run.

rows.label: gemini
rows.text: home and family plans get redone.

rows.label: sagittarius
rows.text: work wants a do-over. pick one fight.

rows.label: taurus
rows.text: an old flame flickers. you don't owe it fuel.

rows.label: capricorn
rows.text: travel and big plans: reread the fine print.

rows.label: aquarius
rows.text: closeness and trust get a slow rethink.

rows.label: leo
rows.text: money moves wait. spending isn't self-care.

rows.label: aries
rows.text: routines slip. reset the alarm, not your life.

rows.label: cancer
rows.text: old conversations come back. answer kindly.

rows.label: libra
rows.text: more sleep, fewer plans. take it.

rows.label: scorpio
rows.text: a friend group shuffle. stay out of the drama.

slides.headline: slow is not *stuck*. it's the redo.
slides.body: the move: don't start the fight you'll have to finish in spring. say the honest thing once, then let it sit.
